about_the_game:
High above the clouds, where the surface of the world lies lost and forgotten, a new era of kingdoms is about to begin. You are the ruler of a fledgling realm, building across floating islands to forge a thriving empire among the skies.

Gather grain from fertile fields, harvest wood from towering groves, seek knowledge under clear horizons, and nurture the faith of your people. Each choice you make strengthens your realm and shapes its destiny.

Expand to new islands, connect them with trade, and take advantage of unique bonuses hidden within the land. From humble beginnings, you will raise a kingdom that defies gravity itself.

Start small with a single island, gather resources, and unlock new buildings. As you progress, expand to other islands, balance production, and trade resources between them. Every decision brings your realm closer to greatness.

Build Among the Clouds

Raise villages, temples, and workshops across floating islands, shaping a kingdom in the skies.

Manage the Four Pillars of Prosperity

Food, Resources, Research, and Faith are the foundation of your realm. Balance them wisely to keep your kingdom thriving.

Expand Across the Isles

Claim new islands and uncover unique bonuses that boost your production and open new paths for growth.

Trade and Connect

Link your islands and exchange resources to create a strong, interconnected realm.

Skybound Colonies is currently in Early Access

While the experience is fully playable, some features are still in development. The current version includes the complete tutorial campaign, Endless Mode, and the core building mechanics.

However, there are still a few limitations:

  • Progress saving in Endless Mode is not yet available.

  • Expanded settings for fine-tuned sound adjustments and graphic quality controls are planned but not implemented.

Your feedback will help guide future updates and shape the growth of the kingdom!
